note: P3802 (Pro 5:10) — lest strangers be filled with your strength, your labors go to a foreigner. (fill = strangers' satiation, qualifier.)

dims.v: toil — one's painful labour, its fruit lost to a foreigner
the son's painful toil whose fruit is squandered on a stranger's house
the toil coupled to the satiation of strangers that consumes it

etseb (painful toil/labour) — the grievous effort of a lifetime, its fruit drained into a foreigner's house through folly. The inner cost (toil, grief) beneath the material loss. Strangers' FILLING (saba) is their satiation (qualifier).
